era: 1873 年生于广东新会茶坑村一个耕读之家——'数百年书香未断'；四岁起随祖父读四书，十一岁考秀才补博士弟子员，十六岁中举人，主考官以妹相许（李蕙仙）——少年得志冠绝乡里；1890 年入京会试下第，归途购得《瀛环志略》，同年拜入康有为万木草堂——'生平知有学自兹始'；1895 年随康有为发动'公车上书'，主笔《时务报》'变法通议'，'笔锋常带感情'名动天下，与谭嗣同并称'浏阳双杰'之外更得'康梁'并称；1898 年戊戌变法百日而败，亡命日本——创办《清议报》《新民丛报》，发《新民说》二十节，'欲维新吾国，当先维新吾民'成为一代启蒙纲领；1903 年游美归来思想转趋保守，发《开明专制论》，与《民报》论战至 1907 年败选停刊；辛亥后归国，组进步党、任司法总长、财政总长，1915 年与学生蔡锷策动护国运动反袁称帝——'吾侪不惜身命，为国家争人格'；1917 年退出政坛，晚年讲学清华国学研究院，著《清代学术概论》《中国历史研究法》《中国近三百年学术史》；1929 年 1 月病逝于北京，'几于无人不读饮冰室'——一生著述约一千四百万字，自评'学问欲极炽'而'不惜以今日之我，难昔日之我'
era_en: Born 1873 in Chakeng village, Xinhui, Guangdong, into a family of farmers and scholars whose 'bookish line had not broken for centuries'; reading the Four Books with his grandfather from four, taking the xiucai at eleven and the juren at sixteen — the chief examiner sought him as brother-in-law; in 1890, failing the metropolitan examination, he bought the Gazette of the World's Geography on the road home and that year entered Kang Youwei's Hall of the Ten Thousand Trees — 'from this day I first knew what learning was'; in 1895 he joined Kang's 'petition of the examination candidates', and as chief writer of the Chinese Progress his 'Reform Essays' — 'the brush-tip always charged with feeling' — shook the empire: the world spoke of 'Kang-Liang'; in 1898 the Hundred Days fell and he fled to Japan — founding the China Discussion and the New People's Magazine, publishing the twenty chapters of the New Citizen: 'to renew our state, first renew our people', the enlightenment programme of a generation; returning from America in 1903 he turned conservative, publishing On Enlightened Autocracy, and fought the Min Bao to defeat and closure in 1907; after the 1911 revolution he returned home, led the Progressive Party, served as Minister of Justice and of Finance, and in 1915 joined his student Cai E in the National Protection Movement against Yuan's imperial bid — 'we stake our lives to win standing for the nation'; from 1917 he left politics, lecturing in his last years at the Tsinghua Research Institute of National Learning — the Intellectual Trends of the Qing, the Historical Research Methods, the Intellectual History of the Last Three Hundred Years; he died in Beijing in January 1929 — 'scarcely a man had not read the Ice-Drinking Studio', some fourteen million characters in all, his self-verdict 'a thirst for learning at white heat, sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self'
school: 新民政治哲学 / 新文体传播工程 / 史界革命与史料总账 / 概念界碑重合 / 流亡舆论网络 / 过渡阶梯论 / 观念市场论
historical_significance: 中国近代思想启蒙的第一支笔：从《时务报》到《新民丛报》，他以'笔锋常带感情'的新文体把'国民''权利''国家'等现代概念植入汉语——清末青年'几于无人不读饮冰室'，一代革命者、学者、政治家皆自称读梁启超长大；他发动的'史界革命'以《新史学》把二十四史贬为'二十四姓家谱'，为中国现代史学立了'国民总账'的记账主体；他在戊戌后的十四年流亡中把报刊做成跨国舆论工程，证明政治迫害的地理半径不等于影响力的半径；'不惜以今日之我难昔日之我'的自我更新哲学，'开明专制'的过渡阶梯设计，清华国学院的'研究法'讲义——他在政治、学术、文体三条战线上同时立法；晚年自评'学问欲极炽'而成果约一千四百万字，是中国传统士人向现代知识分子转型的完成态样本
historical_significance_en: The first pen of China's modern enlightenment: from the Chinese Progress to the New People's Magazine, his 'new style' — 'the brush-tip ever charged with feeling' — planted the modern concepts of citizen, rights and nation into Chinese; 'scarcely a young man of the late Qing had not read the Ice-Drinking Studio', and a generation of revolutionaries, scholars and statesmen claimed to have grown up reading Liang; his 'revolution in history' — the New History demoting the Twenty-Four Histories to 'family registers of twenty-four surnames' — set the accounting entity of the 'national grand ledger' for modern Chinese historiography; in fourteen years of exile after 1898 he engineered the periodical into a transnational work of opinion, proving that the geographic radius of persecution does not bound the radius of influence; 'sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self' as a philosophy of self-renewal, the transition ladder of 'enlightened autocracy', the 'methods' lectures at Tsinghua — on three fronts at once, politics, scholarship and prose, he legislated; some fourteen million characters at a self-rated 'white heat of the thirst for learning' — the completed specimen of the Chinese literatus becoming the modern intellectual
unique_thinking: 梁启超的思维内核是'以人为最后工程'的认识论：制度、文体、史学皆是人这个变量的下游——'苟有新民，何患无新制度'，因此他把全部能量投向锻造（新民）、传输（新文体）、清点（史料总账）三个上游环节；第二个内核是'界碑重合'的语言工程：旧词装新义、托古立源、高频固化——汉语的现代词汇系统相当部分出自这次工程；第三个内核是把'善变'制度化为公开自我更新：'不惜以今日之我难昔日之我'——转向必须带理由、可核对、可记账；第四个内核是流亡与失意的杠杆化：政治迫害的地理半径不等于影响力半径，败选也要遵守市场规则；他的一切方法背后是同一种能源——'内热如焚，饮冰自课'：把对时代的焦虑折算成每天的产出定额，一生约一千四百万字，直至生命最后两年
unique_thinking_en: Liang Qichao's cognitive core is an epistemology that takes the human being as the final engineering object: institutions, prose style, historiography are all downstream of the variable 'the person' — 'given new citizens, why fear the want of new institutions'; hence he threw his energy at the three upstream processes: forging (the new citizen), transmitting (the new style), auditing (the grand ledger of sources); his second core is the linguistic engineering of the boundary-stone reset: old words carrying new senses, sources lodged in the classics, high-frequency setting — a fair portion of the modern Chinese vocabulary is the bequest of this works; the third core is institutionalising changeableness as public self-renewal: 'sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self' — every turn argued with reasons, checkable, kept on ledger; the fourth is the leverage of exile and defeat: the geographic radius of persecution does not bound the radius of influence, and even the loser must keep the rules of the market; beneath all his methods runs one energy source — 'a fire within, quenched by drinking ice': the anxiety for the age converted into a daily output quota, some fourteen million characters in a life, to the final two years
civilization_zh: 晚清民初的转型社会：科举废弛与新学兴替造成的知识人身份断裂、戊戌变法与清季新政的国家危亡语境、通商口岸报刊出版业催生的公共舆论空间、明治日本作为思想中转站的译介通道、从'天下'到'国家'的概念重构压力、流亡知识社群（横滨-东京-巴黎）的跨域网络、旧学根柢与新知翻译夹击下'笔锋常带感情'的报刊文体革命
civilization_en: The transforming society of late Qing and early Republic: the identity rupture of the literati between the dying examinations and the rise of new learning, the context of national crisis of the Hundred Days' Reform and the late-Qing New Policies, the public sphere of press and publishing opened by the treaty ports, Meiji Japan as the relay station of translated thought, the conceptual strain of rebuilding 'all under Heaven' into 'the nation-state', the cross-border network of exile communities (Yokohama-Tokyo-Paris), and the revolution of journalistic prose — 'the brush-tip always carrying feeling' — forged between classical learning and translated modern knowledge
roles_zh: 思想家（《新民说》作者、'新民'概念的立法者）；报业家（《时务报》主笔、《清议报》《新民丛报》创办人）；史学家（《新史学》《中国历史研究法》、史界革命的发动者）；政治家（进步党领袖、司法与财政总长、护国运动策动者）；教育家（清华国学研究院导师、讲学一生）
roles_en: Thinker (author of the New Citizen, the legislator of the concept of 'the citizen'); pressman (chief writer of the Chinese Progress; founder of the China Discussion and the New People's Magazine); historian (the New History and the Historical Research Methods; instigator of the revolution in history); statesman (leader of the Progressive Party, Minister of Justice and of Finance, co-planner of the National Protection Movement); educator (mentor at the Tsinghua Research Institute, lecturer all his life)

modes.domain_zh: 政治哲学/把'国民性'当作可锻造的工程对象——国家的现代化先于并依赖'人'的现代化，新民是变法的第一道工序
modes.domain_en: Political philosophy / treating national character as an object open to engineering — the modernisation of persons precedes and underwrites that of the state; the new citizen is the first process of reform
modes.definition_zh: 政治哲学方法论/《新民说》的起点是一个诊断：历次变法失败的根子不在制度而在人——'苟有新民，何患无新制度、无新政府、无新国家'；梁启超把'民'从政治的被动客体重新定义为可锻造的工程材料，并列出锻造清单：公德、国家思想、权利思想、自由、自治、自尊、合群、生利分利、毅力、尚武；操作上有两个特征：其一'采补所本无而新之'——从域外引进公民观念补旧学之缺，但'淬厉其所本有而新之'——绝不连根拔弃传统，锻造是合金不是置换；其二以报刊为锻造炉：《新民丛报》把抽象的国民理论写成连载的国民教程，每期几万字直达数万读者——这是把'改造国民性'从士大夫内部讨论变成面向大众的持续工程，比鲁迅的解剖更早、比通俗教科书的制度化更灵活；他自称'新民子'，把写作本身当作国民再造的现场作业
modes.definition_en: Political-philosophy methodology: the New Citizen essays open with a diagnosis — repeated reforms failed not in institutions but in people: 'given new citizens, why fear the want of new institutions, a new government, a new state'; Liang Qichao redefined the people from passive objects of politics to engineering material open to forging, and drew up the forge list: public morality, national consciousness, the sense of rights, liberty, self-rule, self-respect, the capacity to associate, to produce and to distribute, perseverance, martial vigour; two features mark the method: first, 'to take what we lack and renew it' — importing civic concepts from abroad to fill the gaps of the old learning, while 'to temper what we already have and renew it' — never uprooting tradition wholesale; forging is alloying, not replacement; second, the periodical as forge: the New People's Magazine turned abstract theory of citizenship into serialised tutorials, tens of thousands of words reaching tens of thousands of readers per issue — turning the remaking of national character from salon discussion into a mass production line, earlier than Lu Xun's dissections and nimbler than the textbook's institutional route; he styled himself 'the New Citizen', treating writing itself as the live worksite of national re-creation
modes.source_chapter: 《新民说》(1902-1906，《新民丛报》连载)；《新民丛报》发刊词
modes.key_quote_zh: 苟有新民，何患无新制度、无新政府、无新国家——改造国家之前，先把'民'当作可以锻造的材料。
modes.key_quote_en: Given new citizens, why fear the want of new institutions, a new government, a new state — before remaking the country, treat the people as material that can be forged.
key_concepts: 人的现代化优先 human modernisation first（制度移植若无新民承接则空转——变法的第一道工序是人）
human modernisation first (transplanted institutions idle without new citizens to run them — the first process of reform is the person)
淬厉与采补并行的合金锻造 alloying of tempering and import（'本有'与'本无'各取一半——改造不是置换传统）
alloying of tempering and import (half from what we have, half from what we lack — remaking is not replacing tradition)
报刊锻造炉 the periodical forge（连载把理论写成国民教程——写作本身是改造工程现场）
the periodical forge (serialisation turns theory into citizenship tutorials — writing itself is the worksite of transformation)
process_zh: 先诊断后开方：变法失败先问'承接制度的国民具备了哪些素质'——缺什么补什么，列锻造清单
合金配方：每一项素质都标明来源——传统中淬厉什么、域外采补什么——拒绝全盘置换
连载量产：把公民理论切成可连载的专题——每篇解决一项素质，读者按期跟进
以文为业：认定锻造国民是长期工程——用报刊的连续性对抗一次运动的一次性
process_en: Diagnose before prescribing: on failed reform, first ask 'what qualities do the citizens who must run the institutions possess' — list the forge items against the gaps
Design the alloy: for each quality mark its source — what to temper from tradition, what to import from abroad — refuse wholesale replacement
Serialise for scale: cut civic theory into serialisable units — one instalment one quality, readers follow issue by issue
Make writing the trade: accept that forging citizens is a long undertaking — let the periodical's continuity outlast the one-shot movement
representative_cases_zh: 《新民丛报》连载《新民说》四年：二十节专题覆盖公德到尚武——清末青年一代'几于无人不读'，毛泽东自述少年时'读了又读，直到可以背出来'
'采补'与'淬厉'的双轨实证：论公德引伯伦知理与孟子并置——国家观念从忠君中淬厉而出，权利观念自泰西采补而入
晚清新式学堂的公民教材大量取材于《新民说》——报刊锻造的成果被制度化反向吸收
representative_cases_en: Four years of serialising the New Citizen in the New People's Magazine: twenty themed chapters from public morality to martial vigour — 'scarcely a young man of the late Qing did not read it'; Mao Zedong recalled reading it 'again and again until I could recite it'

The two tracks of tempering and import in practice: the essay on public morality sets Bluntschli beside Mencius — the idea of the state tempered out of loyalty to the throne, the idea of rights imported from the West
Late-Qing new-style schools drew heavily on the New Citizen for their civic texts — the forge's output was institutionally reabsorbed
modern_applications_zh: 组织文化建设：先把'承接新制度的人具备什么素质'列清单逐项锻造——制度上线与人岗转型并行
教育产品设计：公民/领导力课程按'素质专题'连载式推进——每单元解决一项，避免一次性灌输
社会运动：把'改造观念'写成面向大众的连载内容——用媒体连续性对抗运动的一次性
modern_applications_en: Organisational culture: list the qualities the people who must run the new institution need, and forge them item by item — institution go-live and role transformation run in parallel
Educational design: run civic or leadership curricula as serialised quality-units — one unit one quality, never one-shot indoctrination
Social movements: write 'changing minds' as serialised mass content — let media continuity outlast the movement's moment
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
福泽谕吉（思想源流：《文明论概略》'一身独立而后一国独立'——新民论的域外参照）

modes.domain_zh: 传播方法论/以情感浓度驱动的'新文体'把思想传播的效率提高一个数量级——'务为平易畅达，纵笔所至不检束'
modes.domain_en: Communication methodology / a 'new style' driven by emotional charge raises the efficiency of the transmission of ideas by an order of magnitude — 'always plain and fluent, the brush running free and unbound'
modes.definition_zh: 传播方法论/梁启超对文体的自觉是空前的：'务为平易畅达，时杂以俚语、韵语及外国语法，纵笔所至不检束'——'条理明晰，笔锋常带感情，对于读者，别有一种魔力'；他的诊断是：桐城古文与八股都不再能承载新思想——前者太省，后者太死，思想的传输带宽必须重造；新文体的技术要点有三：其一欧化句法与排比堆叠——把复合概念的逻辑关系写进句法本身；其二情感即带宽——'笔锋带感情'不是修辞装饰，是让读者在共鸣中降低理解阻力；其三俗语入文——把士大夫垄断的书面语向大众口语开放；结果是他一个人垄断了'舆论界之威权'：清末数万读者读《新民丛报》如痴如醉——文体工程证明了一个传播学定律：思想的接收成本每降一分，传播半径扩大一环；他也付出了代价：为赶报刊周期'应酬文字'泛滥，晚年自省'浅尝辄止'——高带宽通道同时放大了思想的粗糙
modes.definition_en: Communication methodology: Liang Qichao's self-consciousness about prose style was unprecedented: 'always plain and fluent, now and then mixed with the vernacular, with verse and with foreign syntax, the brush running wherever it will, unbound' — 'clear in logic, the brush-tip ever charged with feeling, holding for readers a peculiar magic'; his diagnosis: neither the Tongcheng classical prose nor the examination essay could any longer carry the new thought — the one too spare, the other dead; the transmission bandwidth of ideas had to be rebuilt; three technical points of the new style: first, Europeanised syntax and piled parallelism — writing the logical relations of compound concepts into the grammar itself; second, feeling as bandwidth — 'the brush-tip charged with feeling' is no ornament but lowers the reader's resistance through resonance; third, the vernacular admitted into writing — opening the literati monopoly of the written language to popular speech; the result: he alone held 'the authority of the world of opinion'; tens of thousands of late-Qing readers devoured the New People's Magazine — the style-engineering proved a law of transmission: every bit the reception cost falls, the radius of spread widens by a ring; he also paid the price: churning out 'occasional writing' against magazine deadlines, in later life he confessed to 'tasting shallowly and stopping' — the high-bandwidth channel equally amplifies the coarseness of the thought
modes.source_chapter: 梁启超《清代学术概论》自述'新文体'；《少年中国说》《新民说》文体实践
modes.key_quote_zh: 条理明晰，笔锋常带感情，对于读者，别有一种魔力——文体不是外衣，是思想的传输带宽。
modes.key_quote_en: Clear in logic, the brush-tip ever charged with feeling, holding for readers a peculiar magic — style is not a coat; it is the transmission bandwidth of thought.
key_concepts: 情感即带宽 feeling as bandwidth（共鸣降低理解阻力——传播效率的杠杆不在信息量在情感量）
feeling as bandwidth (resonance lowers the resistance of understanding — the lever of transmission is not information mass but feeling mass)
句法承载逻辑 syntax carries logic（欧化句式与排比把概念关系写进语法——复杂思想不再依赖读者补全）
syntax carries logic (Europeanised clauses and parallelism write conceptual relations into grammar — complex thought no longer trusts the reader to complete it)
带宽税 the bandwidth tax（高情感通道同时放大粗糙——赶周期的'应酬文字'是工程的质量债）
the bandwidth tax (the high-feeling channel amplifies coarseness too — deadline-churned 'occasional writing' is the quality debt of the engineering)
process_zh: 先重造传输层：传播新思想前先问'现有文体能否承载'——旧文体的带宽上限决定传播上限
句法升级：把复杂概念关系写成显性句法结构——排比、欧化长句、定义句式按需调用
按情感配平：每篇先定'读者读完该有什么感受'——情感浓度按传播目标设计而非自然流露
设质量红线：为高带宽通道预设'不做应酬文字'的自我约束——带宽放大一切，包括粗糙
process_en: Rebuild the transport layer first: before spreading new ideas ask 'can the existing style carry them' — the old style's bandwidth ceiling caps the spread
Upgrade the syntax: write complex conceptual relations as explicit structures — parallelism, Europeanised long sentences, definitional forms, as needed
Balance by feeling: decide before each piece 'what the reader must feel on finishing' — design the emotional charge to the aim of transmission, not to spontaneity
Set a quality floor: pre-commit the high-bandwidth channel to 'no occasional writing' — bandwidth amplifies everything, coarseness included
representative_cases_zh: 《少年中国说》的'红日初升，其道大光'：四言铺排加情感递进——一篇雄文成为清末学界的启蒙符号，几十年后仍入课本
《新民丛报》对《时务报》的文体迭代：从'时务文体'到'新民文体'，句法欧化加码——清末报刊业整体被他的文体改造
晚年《清代学术概论》自我清算：'以文勒石'的自省——他第一个把'笔锋带感情'的工程成本写进了自己的学术史
representative_cases_en: 'The young China is the rising sun, its way all light' from Ode to Young China: four-character crescendos with rising feeling — one essay became the enlightenment emblem of late-Qing letters, textbook material decades on

The style-iteration from the Chinese Progress to the New People's Magazine: from 'current-affairs style' to 'new-citizen style', syntax further Europeanised — the entire late-Qing press was remodelled by his prose

The late self-audit in the Intellectual Trends of the Qing: the self-critique of 'writing to move the stone' — he was the first to enter the engineering cost of 'the feeling-charged brush' into his own history of scholarship
modern_applications_zh: 知识传播：产品文案先测'传输带宽'——句子结构承载逻辑、情感配平按目标设计
品牌叙事：把品牌理念写成'读者读完该有什么感受'的文体规范——情感浓度是设计变量
内容工业：为高频产出设'不应酬'红线——高带宽通道的质量债同样被放大
modern_applications_en: Knowledge diffusion: test the 'transmission bandwidth' of copy first — sentence structure carries the logic, the feeling balance designed to target
Brand narrative: write the brand idea into a style rule of 'what the reader must feel on finishing' — emotional charge as a design variable
Content industry: set a 'no occasional writing' floor against high-frequency output — the quality debt of the high-bandwidth channel is amplified too
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
韩愈（思想源流：'文以载道'的传播自觉之古典型）
丘吉尔（对照：'以修辞动员国家'的现代同构——演讲带宽与报刊带宽的两种杠杆）

modes.domain_zh: 生存方法论/把政治流亡从灾难重定义为杠杆—— exile 不是逃亡的终点而是影响力跨国的支点
modes.domain_en: Survival methodology / redefining political exile from disaster into leverage — exile is not the terminus of flight but the fulcrum of transnational influence
modes.definition_zh: 生存方法论/戊戌政变后梁启超亡命日本十四年，他的第一个动作不是舔伤而是建设：办《清议报》《新民丛报》、在横滨办大同学校、组织政闻社——把逃亡路线直接变成海外舆论基地；流亡杠杆的操作要点有三：其一'地利转换'——日本明治维新的成功样本近在眼前，他把流亡地当作观察站与中转站（'日本维新之治，得力于翻译'——大量西学经由日译转手入华）；其二'身份重定义'——朝廷钦犯在海外重定义为'舆论领袖'：清廷的通缉令反而成了全球华人社区的名片；其三'遥控母国'——报刊从横滨直投上海与南洋，清廷鞭长莫及；这是中国古代'贬谪文学'传统（退而著书）的现代升级：贬谪是向内的（独乐园式的书局），流亡是向外的（跨国网络式的舆论战）；梁启超证明了：只要思想产品能跨境流通，政治迫害的地理半径就不再是影响力的半径
modes.definition_en: Survival methodology: after the coup of 1898 Liang Qichao fled to Japan for fourteen years; his first act was not licking wounds but building — founding the China Discussion and the New People's Magazine, opening the Datong School in Yokohama, organising the Zhengwen Society — converting the flight route directly into an overseas base of opinion; three operating points of the exile lever: first, 'the conversion of ground' — the success sample of Meiji Japan lay before his eyes, and he used the place of exile as observation post and relay ('Japan's reform owed itself to translation' — much Western learning passed through Japanese renderings into China); second, 'the redefinition of identity' — the wanted criminal of the court redefined abroad as 'leader of opinion': the imperial warrant became a visiting card in the global Chinese communities; third, 'the remote control of the homeland' — the magazines shipped from Yokohama straight into Shanghai and the South Seas, beyond the reach of the court; this is the modern upgrade of the ancient tradition of exile literature (retiring to write): banishment turned inward (the Garden of Solitude's book office), exile turns outward (a transnational network of opinion-war); Liang proved that so long as the products of thought can cross borders, the geographic radius of political persecution is no longer the radius of influence
modes.source_chapter: 梁启超亡命日本时期 (1898-1912)：《清议报》《新民丛报》；《夏威夷游记》
modes.key_quote_zh: 朝廷能追缉我的身体，追缉不了从横滨发出的每一期报纸——流亡不是影响力的终点，是它的跨国支点。
modes.key_quote_en: The court can hunt my body, not every issue shipped from Yokohama — exile is not the end of influence but its transnational fulcrum.
key_concepts: 地利转换 conversion of ground（流亡地当作观察站与中转站——被迫的位移变成主动的信息位）
conversion of ground (the place of exile as observation post and relay — forced displacement becomes a chosen information position)
身份重定义 identity redefinition（钦犯在海外重定义为舆论领袖——迫害文书反向背书声望）
identity redefinition (the wanted man redefined abroad as opinion leader — the persecution document counter-endorses the fame)
跨国遥控 transnational remote control（产品跨境流通则迫害半径≠影响半径——影响力与地理解耦）
transnational remote control (when the product crosses borders, the radius of persecution no longer equals the radius of influence — influence decoupled from geography)
process_zh: 落地先建阵地：抵达流亡地第一优先级是重建生产系统（报刊/学校/社团）——不是休整而是开工
把流亡地当信息位：主动利用当地的知识落差（日译西学）做转口贸易——被迫位移的信息优势要榨取
重写身份叙事：把通缉令转化为公信力证据——'被旧体制迫害'是新舆论场里的硬通货
建跨境分发：保证思想产品能回流母国——迫害的地理半径失效是杠杆成立的前提
process_en: Build the position on landing: the first priority upon reaching the place of exile is rebuilding the production system (press, school, society) — not rest but commencement of works

Treat exile ground as an information position: exploit the local knowledge gradient (Japanese renderings of Western learning) as entrepôt trade — extract the informational advantage of the forced displacement
Rewrite the identity narrative: turn the warrant into evidence of credibility — 'persecuted by the old regime' is hard currency in the new field of opinion
Build cross-border distribution: ensure the products of thought can flow back to the homeland — the failure of the persecution's geographic radius is the premise of the lever
representative_cases_zh: 横滨《清议报》创刊 (1898)：戊戌政变仅百余日后即出报——'为国民之耳目'的发刊词把逃亡直接转化为阵地建设
日译西学的转口工程：'和文汉读法'推广与《清议报》译载——明治日本成为梁启超版的'思想保税区'
庚子后清廷'招抚'试探：流亡声望反成谈判筹码——朝廷不得不承认海外舆论场的存在
representative_cases_en: The China Discussion founded in Yokohama (1898): barely a hundred days after the coup, its inaugural statement 'to be the eyes and ears of the citizens' converted flight directly into position-building
The entrepôt of Japanese translation: the promoted 'method of reading Japanese with Chinese eyes' and the China Discussion's translated pages — Meiji Japan became Liang's bonded warehouse of thought
The court's probes of 'pacification' after 1900: the exile's repute itself became a bargaining chip — the throne had to recognise the existence of the overseas field of opinion
modern_applications_zh: 职业流亡：被驱逐出核心圈后优先重建生产系统（自媒体/咨询/开源）——而非休整或报复
跨境知识套利：利用所在国与母国的知识落差做'思想转口'——位移本身是信息优势
个人品牌：把'被迫离开'重写为叙事资产——迫害性事件在公开市场常为公信力背书
modern_applications_en: Career exile: expelled from the inner circle, rebuild the production system first (media, consulting, open source) — not rest, not revenge
Cross-border knowledge arbitrage: exploit the knowledge gradient between host country and homeland as 'thought entrepôt' — displacement itself is informational advantage
Personal brand: rewrite 'forced departure' as a narrative asset — persecution-grade events often endorse credibility in the open market
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
司马光（对照：'屏居著书法'——同是政治失意，书局向内、舆论网络向外的两种资产重组）
马克思（同道：伦敦流亡期的写作与通信网络——流亡作为思想生产的最优条件之一）

modes.domain_zh: 概念工程方法论/在思想剧变期重铸旧词的边界——'新'字诀：旧词装新义，让传统为变革背书
modes.domain_en: Conceptual-engineering methodology / recasting the boundary of old words in a time of intellectual upheaval — the 'new' trick: old terms carry new meanings, so that tradition endorses the change
modes.definition_zh: 概念工程方法论/梁启超面对的难题是：要引入'国民''权利''国家'这类全新概念，但读者只熟悉旧词汇系统；他的解法是界碑重合：不造新词（造了没人看懂），而是给旧词重划边界——'新民'借《大学》'作新民'之古义装现代公民之实；'革命'从王朝易姓重铸为'群治进步之公例'（'革命者，天演之公例也'——把革命从政变重定义为普遍规律）；'国家'从'朝廷'中剥离（'朝廷由正式而成立者，国家之不正式者也'——国家是全体国民之公产）；操作上有三个层次：其一'托古'——从经典中找到旧词的合法源头（新民出《大学》、大同出《礼运》）；其二'重定义'——保留旧词的字面，重写它的内涵边界；其三'高频灌输'——以报刊连载让新边界成为阅读惯例；这是语言层面的修屋法：不推倒词汇大厦，逐间重划房间——百年汉语的现代词汇系统，相当一部分是这次界碑重合的遗产
modes.definition_en: Conceptual-engineering methodology: Liang's problem was that he had to introduce wholly new concepts — citizen, rights, nation-state — into readers fluent only in the old lexical system; his answer was the boundary-stone reset: coin no new words (coined, none would understand), but redraw the boundary of old ones — 'new-min' (new the people) took the ancient gloss of the Great Learning to carry the substance of the modern citizen; 'revolution' was recast from dynastic change of surname into 'the universal law of social progress' ('revolution is the general law of evolution' — revolution redefined from coup to regularity); 'the state' was detached from 'the court' ('a court formally established is precisely not a state formally established' — the state is the common property of all citizens); three layers of operation: first, 'lodging in the classics' — find the old word's legitimate source in the canon (new-min from the Great Learning, the Great Unity from the Rites); second, 'redefinition' — keep the old word's face, rewrite the boundary of its sense; third, 'high-frequency inculcation' — serialised in the press until the new boundary becomes a habit of reading; this is house-repair at the level of language: never demolish the lexical mansion, redraw the rooms one by one — a fair portion of the modern Chinese vocabulary is the bequest of this resetting of boundary stones
modes.source_chapter: 《新民说·释新民之义》；《释革》(1902)；《论政府与人民之权限》
modes.key_quote_zh: 新民二字，取《大学》'作新民'之古义，而别有会心——不是造新词，是给旧词重划边界。
modes.key_quote_en: 'New the people' takes the ancient gloss of the Great Learning, yet carries a meaning of my own — the task is not to coin new words but to redraw the boundary of old ones.
key_concepts: 托古立源 lodging in the classics（为新义找到旧词的经典源头——合法性的借力打力）
lodging in the classics (find the canonical source of the old word for the new sense — legitimacy borrowed to lever change)
字面保留、边界重写 keep the face, redraw the boundary（旧词是接口新义是载荷——读者平滑迁移）
keep the face, redraw the boundary (the old word is the interface, the new sense the payload — readers migrate smoothly)
高频固化 high-frequency setting（新边界靠报刊连载固化为阅读惯例——概念工程需要流量工程配套）
high-frequency setting (the new boundary set into reading habit by serialisation — conceptual engineering needs traffic engineering as its complement)
process_zh: 盘点旧词资产：引入新概念前先查'哪个旧词的字面最接近、经典地位最高'——重合优于新造
三步重划：托古立源→重写内涵边界→报刊高频灌输——让新义在旧字形里生根
护住接口：新旧义交替期允许双解并存——不制造'读者看不懂'的断崖
监视漂移：新边界流行后警惕旧义回潮——重定义是持续工程非一锤子买卖
process_en: Inventory the lexical assets: before importing a new concept, find the old word whose face is nearest and whose canonical rank is highest — recasting beats coining
Redraw in three steps: lodge in the classics → rewrite the boundary of the sense → inculcate at press frequency — let the new sense take root inside the old glyph
Guard the interface: in the transition allow both readings side by side — never manufacture a cliff of incomprehension
Watch the drift: once the new boundary circulates, guard against the old sense seeping back — redefinition is a continuing works, not a one-stroke deal
representative_cases_zh: '新民'的界碑重合：《大学》'作新民'与伯伦知理国民学说在《新民说》里完成焊接——一个旧词从此承担现代公民语义
《释革》对'革命'的重铸：区分'Reform'与'Revolution'，把'革命'从汤武易姓扩至'一切群治进步'——后来者的革命话语都在这道界碑内活动
'国家/朝廷'的剥离工程：《论政府与人民之权限》以'公产'重定义国家——为立宪话语清出地基
representative_cases_en: The reset of 'new the people': the Great Learning's gloss welded to Bluntschli's theory of the citizen in the New Citizen essays — one old word thenceforth carried the semantics of modern citizenship

The recasting of 'revolution' in On Reform: distinguishing Reform from Revolution, widening 'revolution' from the change of dynasty between Tang and Wu to 'all progress of social order' — the revolutionary discourse of later generations moved within these boundary stones
The detachment of state from court: On the Limits of Government and People redefined the state as common property — clearing the ground for constitutional discourse
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革话语：推动新制度时'重定义旧词'（如把'绩效'重铸为'共同成果'）——降低概念切换成本
产品设计：功能升级沿用旧入口、重写心智边界——用户平滑迁移而非被迫换app
公共沟通：新政策借既有词汇立源再重写边界——托古立源是跨代际沟通的杠杆
modern_applications_en: Organisational change language: to drive a new institution, redefine an old word (recast 'performance' as 'shared outcome') — cut the cost of conceptual switching
Product design: upgrade along the old entry point and rewrite its mental boundary — users migrate smoothly instead of being forced to a new app
Public communication: for a new policy, lodge its source in an existing word, then redraw the boundary — lodging in the classics levers cross-generational communication
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
孔子（思想源流：'必也正名乎'——名实工程的最早立法者）
奥威尔（对照：'新话'——同一工程的黑暗镜像：重铸边界用于解放还是控制，取决于谁执笔）

modes.name_zh: 今日之我与昨日之我战法
modes.name_en: Today's Self Wars Yesterday's Self Method
modes.domain_zh: 认识论/把'善变'制度化为公开的自我更新——'不惜以今日之我，难昔日之我'，观点随证据与局势演进并公示转向
modes.domain_en: Epistemology / institutionalising changeableness as public self-renewal — 'sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self': views evolve with evidence and circumstance, and the turn is publicised
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/《清代学术概论》里梁启超对自己最著名的判词：'启超'学问欲'极炽'，'常自觉其学未成……不惜以今日之我，难昔日之我'；时人讥其'流质易变'，他把这重定义为认识论美德：思想若不许更新，'则思想界无复有进步'；操作结构有三：其一'公开转向'——每次重大立场变化（保皇到开明专制到联袁）都在报刊上明说理由，旧我新我的论战在同一版面上可见；其二'以今日攻昨日'——不是悄悄改口，是把旧文的缺陷当作靶子公开打；其三'变化本身记账'——晚年《清代学术概论》把自己的善变作为研究对象解剖，转向史成为方法论的样本；代价是政治信用的折旧（时人讥'反复无常'），收益是思想跟住真实世界——在'君子一以贯之'为最高德性的文化里，他立法了另一种德性：观点的可错性与可更新性
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology: in the Intellectual Trends Liang left his most famous self-verdict: his thirst for learning 'at white heat', 'ever aware his learning unfinished … sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self'; contemporaries mocked his 'fluid, changeable nature'; he redefined this as an epistemic virtue: were thought forbidden to renew itself, 'the world of thought would know no further progress'; the operating structure has three parts: first, the public turn — every major change of position (from royalism to enlightened autocracy to alliance with Yuan) argued with reasons in the press, the debate of old self and new visible on the same page; second, 'today attacking yesterday' — not a quiet retraction but the defects of the old essay taken up openly as target; third, 'keeping the ledger of change' — in late life the Intellectual Trends dissected his own changeableness as its object of study, the history of turns becoming a specimen of method; the cost is the depreciation of political credit (mocked as 'fickleness'), the gain is thought that keeps pace with the real world — in a culture that held 'the gentleman is consistent throughout' the highest virtue, he legislated another: the fallibility and renewability of one's views
modes.source_chapter: 《清代学术概论》第二十六节自述；《新民丛报》与《时报》论战文本
modes.key_quote_zh: 不惜以今日之我，难昔日之我——观点不许更新，思想界就再无进步。
modes.key_quote_en: Sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self — forbid views to renew themselves, and the world of thought knows no more progress.
key_concepts: 公开转向 the public turn（改口必附理由且在原舆论场公示——转向是论证不是背弃）
the public turn (every change argued with reasons and publicised in the original arena — a turn is an argument, not a betrayal)
以今日攻昨日 today refuting yesterday（把旧文的缺陷当靶子公开打——自我批判代替无声漂移）
today refuting yesterday (the old essay's defects taken up as open target — self-critique in place of silent drift)
变化记账 the ledger of change（把善变史当研究对象解剖——转向史本身成为方法论样本）
the ledger of change (dissecting one's own history of turns as an object of study — the turn-record itself becomes a specimen of method)
process_zh: 给'改变立场'设程序：转向必须公开说明'什么证据/局势变了'——禁止无声改口
定期自我攻击：把自己早期论述当靶子复审——发现缺陷就写'今我难昔我'的公开修正
变化记账：记录自己的立场史与转向理由——把善变变成可审计的数据而非口碑风险
区分'随势'与'随利'：转向的合法性来自证据与局势，不来自利益——这条线要写进自我法则
process_en: Set a procedure for changing position: every turn must state publicly 'what evidence or circumstance changed' — silent reversal forbidden
Attack yourself on schedule: re-audit your early arguments as targets — on finding defects, publish the open correction of 'today refuting yesterday'
Keep the ledger: record your position history and the reasons of each turn — make changeableness auditable data, not reputational risk
Separate 'following the evidence' from 'following advantage': a turn's legitimacy comes from evidence and circumstance, never from interest — write this line into your self-law
representative_cases_zh: 从保皇到开明专制的公开论证 (1903-1906)：《开明专制论》明说'游美后所见有变'——立场转向与理由同刊
《清代学术概论》的自我解剖 (1920)：把'不惜以今日之我难昔日之我'写进学术史——善变作为方法被正面立论
晚年放弃'诗界革命'旧说：以《中国之美文及其历史》重审早年判断——修正自己比护短更勤
representative_cases_en: The public argument from royalism to enlightened autocracy (1903-06): On Enlightened Autocracy states plainly 'what I saw changed after the American journey' — the turn and its reasons in the same issue
The self-dissection of the Intellectual Trends (1920): 'sparing not to use today's self to refute yesterday's self' written into the history of scholarship — changeableness argued for as method
In late life abandoning his old 'poetic revolution' thesis: re-auditing his early judgments in the Beautiful Verse of China and Their History — revising himself more diligently than defending himself
modern_applications_zh: 组织决策：建立'立场变更公示'制度——重大转向必须附'什么变了'的证据说明
技术选型：公开推翻自己早年的技术判断并记录理由——架构决策日志是'今我难昔我'的工程版
个人成长：把'善变'从品格污点重写为认知资产——但用'转向理由台账'区分求真与投机
modern_applications_en: Organisational decisions: a 'position-change disclosure' rule — every major turn must carry evidence of 'what changed'
Technology choices: openly overturn your own earlier technical judgments and record why — the architecture decision log is the engineering edition of 'today refuting yesterday'
Personal growth: rewrite 'fickleness' from character flaw to cognitive asset — but use a ledger of turn-reasons to tell truth-seeking from opportunism
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
凯恩斯（同道：'当事实变了我就改变看法'——同一德性的经济学表述）
曾国藩（对照：'恒'字哲学——以不变为德性的另一极，两人互为方法论的反题）

modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/把全部史料当'国民总账'清点分类——'中国之旧史，知有朝廷而不知有国家'，重编以国民为记账主体
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / auditing all historical sources as a grand ledger of the nation — 'the old histories of China know the court but not the state'; recompile with the nation as the accounting entity
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/《新史学》开篇的炮火对准二十四史：'二十四史非史也，二十四姓之家谱而已'——旧史的记账主体错了：为朝廷记账，则为一人一家之兴亡；为国民记账，则为群体演进之因果；他的重编方案有三：其一换记账主体——史学的对象从'君史'改为'民史'，'国民之明镜、爱国心之源泉'；其二引进因果律——'历史者，叙述人群进化之现象而求得其公理公例者也'：史不是流水账，是找规律的账；其三确立'史料总账'的清点制度——《中国历史研究法》把史料分为'文字记录'与'文字记录以外'两大类并逐类定鉴别法，正史、档案、金石、外国记载、逸闻口碑皆入账；这是中国史学第一次以'国民总账'的方法论自觉取代'朝廷流水账'的惯性——后来他承认初期'求公理公例'过急（把社会达尔文主义当公例），又以'今日之我难昔日之我'自我修正：总账法本身也入了总账
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: the artillery of the New History opens on the Twenty-Four Histories: 'the Twenty-Four Histories are not history; they are the family registers of twenty-four surnames' — the accounting entity of the old history was wrong: keep accounts for the court and you record the rise and fall of one house; keep them for the nation and you record the causality of a people's evolution; his plan of recompilation has three parts: first, change the accounting entity — the object of history from 'the history of rulers' to 'the history of the people', 'the mirror of the citizen, the fountain of patriotism'; second, import the law of causality — 'history is the narration of the phenomena of the evolution of human groups in search of its general laws': history is not a running account but a ledger kept to find regularities; third, establish the audit system of the grand ledger of sources — the Historical Research Methods of China classifies sources into 'written records' and 'records beyond writing', with rules of authentication for each class: standard histories, archives, bronze and stone, foreign accounts, oral tradition, all entered; this was the first time Chinese historiography replaced the inertia of the 'court's running account' with the methodological self-consciousness of a 'national grand ledger' — later he admitted that the early hunt for 'general laws' had been overhasty (taking social Darwinism for law), and corrected himself by 'today refuting yesterday': the grand-ledger method itself was entered into the grand ledger
modes.source_chapter: 《新史学》(1902)；《中国历史研究法》(1921)；《中国近三百年学术史》
modes.key_quote_zh: 二十四史非史也，二十四姓之家谱而已——换掉记账主体，史才从家谱变成国民总账。
modes.key_quote_en: The Twenty-Four Histories are not history; they are the family registers of twenty-four surnames — change the accounting entity, and history turns from register into the grand ledger of the nation.
key_concepts: 记账主体 the accounting entity（为国民记账而非为朝廷——史学对象决定史料取舍）
the accounting entity (keep accounts for the nation, not the court — the object of history decides what counts as evidence)
因果律入账 causality on the books（史是找'公理公例'的账——流水账升格为规律账）
causality on the books (history is a ledger kept to find general laws — a running account upgraded to a ledger of regularities)
史料清点制度 the audit of sources（文字记录与口传金石逐类定鉴别法——总账有审计规程）
the audit of sources (rules of authentication class by class for records, inscriptions and oral tradition — the grand ledger has its audit procedures)
process_zh: 先定记账主体：任何研究先答'为谁记这本账'——主体决定分类、取舍与解释框架
双轨清点：文字记录与非文字记录（实物、口传、图像）分轨建账——不把档案当唯一证据源
逐类立鉴别法：每类史料定'可信度条件'与'交叉验证规程'——入账前先过鉴
接受总账的自我修订：方法论发现自身的偏误时公开修正——'求公例过急'的教训要写进账本
process_en: Fix the accounting entity first: before any study answer 'for whom is this ledger kept' — the entity decides the taxonomy, the admission and the frame of interpretation
Audit on two tracks: written records and non-written records (artefacts, oral tradition, images) entered on separate tracks — never treat archives as the only source of evidence
Authentication per class: for each class of source set 'conditions of credibility' and 'rules of cross-checking' — every entry audited before it books
Accept the ledger's self-revision: when the method finds its own bias, correct it publicly — the lesson of 'hunting laws too eagerly' belongs in the ledger
representative_cases_zh: 《新史学》对'正统论'的清算：斥历代正统之争为'谬见'——记账主体之争才是史学革命的实质
《中国历史研究法》第五章'史料之搜集与鉴别'：正向搜集加反向搜集（以不常见之史料证常见之事）——清点规程成体系
《中国近三百年学术史》以'学术为国民公器'重写清学——同一记账主体贯穿其晚年著作
representative_cases_en: The settling of accounts with the 'orthodox succession' in the New History: the disputes of legitimacy across dynasties denounced as 'fallacies' — the war over the accounting entity is the substance of the historiographical revolution
Chapter five of the Research Methods, 'the gathering and authentication of sources': forward gathering plus reverse gathering (proving the common by the uncommon) — an audit procedure made systematic
The Intellectual History of the Last Three Hundred Years rewriting Qing learning as 'learning the common property of the nation' — one accounting entity running through his late work
modern_applications_zh: 企业史/复盘库：以'组织'而非'领导'为记账主体建档——CEO更替不改变账本连续性
数据治理：数据分类分级配'可信度条件'与交叉验证规程——入库先过鉴
研究设计：先答'为谁记账'再定指标体系——记账主体错则全盘错
modern_applications_en: Corporate history and post-mortems: keep the ledger with the organisation, not the leader, as accounting entity — CEO turnover must not break ledger continuity
Data governance: pair data classification with 'conditions of credibility' and cross-check rules — every entry audited before it books
Research design: answer 'for whom is the ledger kept' before fixing the metrics — a wrong accounting entity wrongs the whole account
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
司马迁（思想源流：'究天人之际'的通史野心——被《新史学》追认为民史先声）
兰克（对照：同一时代西方史学的'如实直书'——两种史学现代化的并行路径）

modes.domain_zh: 学术传承方法论/把'怎么研究'本身写成书——《中国历史研究法》不给结论给工序：方法论即最高级的学术遗产
modes.domain_en: Methodology of scholarly transmission / writing the 'how to study' itself into books — the Research Methods gives not conclusions but procedures: method is the highest grade of academic bequest
modes.definition_zh: 学术传承方法论/晚年梁启超在清华国学研究院讲《中国历史研究法》及其'补编'：他不满足于留下结论，而是把'结论是怎么做出来的'拆成可复现的工序——史料的搜集（正向/反向）、鉴别（辨伪/年代考订）、整理（同类整理/异比较）、撰写（先定问题再找材料）；这条'研究法著述'路线的自觉在于：结论会过时，工序可以传承——'历史研究法'的书斋里，他同时完成了三件事：自己的研究范式化（把毕生考据经验写成规程）、后学的教学化（清华国学院讲义）、学科的建制化（中国现代史学方法论的第一批教材）；与其同时代学者相比，王国维留二重证据法之'说'，梁启超留的是可操作的'全套工序'——这是'授人以渔'的制度化版本：方法论文本是复利最高的知识资产
modes.definition_en: Methodology of scholarly transmission: in his late years at the Tsinghua Research Institute of National Learning, Liang lectured on the Historical Research Methods and its supplement: unsatisfied with leaving conclusions, he dismantled 'how the conclusion was reached' into reproducible procedures — the gathering of sources (forward and reverse), their authentication (exposing forgeries, dating), their arrangement (sorting the like, comparing the unlike), and the writing (set the question before hunting materials); the self-consciousness of this 'teach-the-method' route: conclusions go stale, procedures can be handed down — within the study of 'historical method' he accomplished three things at once: the paradigmatisation of his own research (a lifetime's experience of textual criticism written as procedure), the pedagogy for successors (lectures at Tsinghua), and the institution-building of a discipline (the first textbooks of modern Chinese historical methodology); compared with his contemporary Wang Guowei, who left the 'doctrine' of the double-evidence method, Liang left a full operable set of procedures — the institutionalised edition of 'teach a man to fish': the methodology text is the knowledge asset of the highest compound interest
modes.source_chapter: 《中国历史研究法》(1921)及《补编》；清华国学研究院讲义 (1925-1927)
modes.key_quote_zh: 结论会过时，工序可以传承——把'怎么研究'写成书，是给后来者的最高复利资产。
modes.key_quote_en: Conclusions go stale; procedures can be handed down — to write the 'how to study' into a book is the asset of the highest compound interest for those who come after.
key_concepts: 工序优先于结论 procedure over conclusion（把'怎么得出'拆成可复现步骤——传承的是装配线不是成品）
procedure over conclusion (dismantle 'how it was reached' into reproducible steps — hand down the assembly line, not the finished good)
一稿三用 one text, three uses（同一讲义同时完成范式化/教学化/建制化——方法论文本是复利资产）
one text, three uses (the same lectures accomplish paradigm, pedagogy and institution-building — the methodology text compounds)
以问题领材料 question leads material（'先定问题再找材料'——工序的入口是问题不是文献）
question leads material ('set the question before hunting materials' — the entry of procedure is the question, not the bibliography)
process_zh: 把个人经验拆工序：每完成一项研究，回顾'哪几步是可复现的'——把隐性操作写成显性规程
以问题为工序入口：方法论第一课永远是'如何定问题'——材料工序从属于问题工序
一稿三用：写成讲义时同时瞄准同行/学生/学科三个读者层——复用最大化
给工序留接口：标注每一步的'适用条件与失效场景'——后来者能改工序而不盲从工序
process_en: Dismantle your experience into procedures: after each study, review 'which steps are reproducible' — write tacit operations as explicit rules
Enter by the question: the first lesson of method is always 'how to set the question' — the procedures of material serve the procedure of the question
One text, three uses: write the lectures aiming at peers, students and the discipline at once — maximise reuse
Leave interfaces in the procedure: mark for every step its 'conditions of validity and scenes of failure' — successors may amend the procedure rather than obey it blindly
representative_cases_zh: 《中国历史研究法》的章节结构：史之意义→过去之中国史学界→史料搜集→鉴别→整理→撰述——一整套工序目录
清华国学院四大导师并立：王国维、梁启超、陈寅恪、赵元任——梁的研究法讲义是其中最直接的'方法教学'
《古书真伪及其年代》：辨伪工序专书——把'这书是谁写的'拆成可考试的步骤
representative_cases_en: The chapter architecture of the Research Methods: the meaning of history → the historiography of old China → gathering sources → authentication → arrangement → composition — a complete table of procedures
The four masters of the Tsinghua institute: Wang Guowei, Liang Qichao, Chen Yinke, Zhao Yuanren — Liang's methods lectures were the most direct 'teaching of method' among them
Authenticity and Dating of Ancient Books: a monograph on the procedure of detecting forgery — dismantling 'who wrote this book' into examinable steps
modern_applications_zh: 组织知识管理：把核心专家的隐性经验写成'研究法手册'——传承工序而非结论
培训体系设计：课程以'如何定问题'开篇——方法论先于知识点的灌输
开源与文档：给每道工序标注适用条件与失效场景——留接口的文档才有传承价值
modern_applications_en: Organisational knowledge management: write the tacit experience of key experts into a 'methods handbook' — hand down procedures, not conclusions
Training design: open every course with 'how to set the question' — method before the灌输 of facts
Open source and documentation: mark each procedure's conditions of validity and scenes of failure — documents with interfaces are the ones that get inherited
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
朱熹（思想源流：读书法的传统谱系——《朱子读书法》是工序化传承的古典前身）
波普尔（对照：以方法论著述定义学科——两种'授人以渔'的知识观）

modes.domain_zh: 政治方法论/承认国民与自身的'程度'约束，设计可滑动的过渡阶梯——'开明专制'作为过渡政体：先提程度再提制度
modes.domain_en: Political methodology / admitting the 'degree' constraints of the people and of oneself, and designing a slidable ladder of transition — 'enlightened autocracy' as a transitional regime: raise the degree first, the institution second
modes.definition_zh: 政治方法论/1903 年游美归来，梁启超公开修正自己：'吾自美国来而梦俄罗斯'——他目睹华埠社会的散漫与共和实验的门槛，判断中国国民'程度不足'，于是提出'开明专制论'：不是拥护专制，而是把'人民程度'设为制度选择的约束变量，设计可滑动的过渡阶梯——开明专制（训练期）→君主立宪（过渡期）→民主（目标态）；操作要点有三：其一'程度审计'——定期评估国民的政治能力（教育、组织、公共意识）而非空谈应然；其二'阶梯设计'——每个阶段有明确的'毕业条件'（开明专制的毕业条件是国民具备立宪能力）；其三'自我降权承诺'——过渡政体必须内置终点站：开明专制的开明，恰恰体现在为取消自己立法；这是与激进革命论和顽固守旧论同时开战的第三条路：'欲速则不达'与'不变则亡'都被'过渡阶梯'吸收——他晚年说'吾爱孔子，吾尤爱真理；吾爱先辈，吾尤爱国家；吾爱其类，吾尤爱其将来'——过渡阶梯的哲学底座是对'将来'的优先承诺
modes.definition_en: Political methodology: returning from America in 1903, Liang openly corrected himself: 'I went to America and dreamed of Russia' — having seen the dispersal of the Chinese quarters and the threshold of the republican experiment, he judged the 'degree' of the Chinese people insufficient, and proposed 'enlightened autocracy': not the advocacy of despotism, but the setting of 'the people's degree' as a constraint variable on institutional choice, and the design of a slidable ladder of transition — enlightened autocracy (the training period) → constitutional monarchy (the transition) → democracy (the target state); three operating points: first, the audit of degree — assess periodically the people's political capacity (education, organisation, public consciousness) instead of declaiming the ought; second, the design of the ladder — each stage carries explicit 'graduation conditions' (enlightened autocracy graduates when the nation is fit for constitutional rule); third, the pledge of self-demotion — the transitional regime must build in its own terminus: the enlightenment of enlightened autocracy lies precisely in legislating for its own cancellation; this is the third road at war with both radical revolution and stubborn conservatism: 'haste makes waste' and 'no change means ruin' are both absorbed into the ladder of transition; 'I love Confucius, but I love truth more; I love my forebears, but I love my country more; I love my kind, but I love its future more' — the philosophical base of the ladder is the priority of the promise to the future
modes.source_chapter: 《开明专制论》(1906)；《新大陆游记》(1904)；《政治学大家伯伦知理之学说》(1903)
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾自美国来而梦俄罗斯——制度不问应然，先问人民程度到哪一级：给变革装上可滑动的阶梯。
modes.key_quote_en: I went to America and dreamed of Russia — ask not what institution ought to be, but at which step the people's degree stands: fit the change with a slidable ladder.
key_concepts: 程度审计 the audit of degree（国民能力是制度选择的约束变量——先测程度再谈应然）
the audit of degree (the people's capacity is the constraint variable of institutional choice — measure the degree before declaiming the ought)
阶梯设计 the ladder design（每阶段设明确毕业条件——过渡不是拖延而是有验收的工程）
the ladder design (explicit graduation conditions at every stage — transition is not delay but a works with acceptance tests)
自我降权承诺 the self-demotion pledge（过渡政体内置取消自己的条款——'开明'的真伪试金石）
the self-demotion pledge (the transitional regime carries its own cancellation clause — the touchstone of whether 'enlightened' is true)
process_zh: 做程度审计：变革前评估承受方的实际能力（技能/组织/共识）——用数据而非立场定起点
设计过渡阶梯：从现状到目标态拆成可验收的阶段——每阶段写明毕业条件与退出条件
内置终点站：任何过渡性安排必须写明'何时交出权力'——没有降权条款的过渡是伪装的固守
允许阶梯回滑：程度退化时降级运行而非硬撑目标态——诚实承认回退比假目标态诚实
process_en: Run the audit of degree: before the change, assess the reformed side's actual capacity (skill, organisation, consensus) — set the starting point by data, not stance
Design the ladder: from status quo to target state, split into acceptable stages — each with its graduation and exit conditions written down
Build in the terminus: every transitional arrangement must state 'when power will be handed over' — a transition without a demotion clause is disguised entrenchment
Allow the ladder to slide back: when the degree regresses, run at the lower stage rather than propping up the target state — honesty about regression outranks a false target state
representative_cases_zh: 《开明专制论》的自我辩论：与《新民丛报》前两年的共和主张自相攻驳——同刊登出、理由并列
《新大陆游记》的证据链：旧金山华埠堂斗、纽约政党分肥的目击记录——程度审计的原始数据
与革命派的论战分寸：他反'速成共和'却同情宪政目标——阶梯的终点与革命者共享，分野只在路径
representative_cases_en: The self-debate of On Enlightened Autocracy: attacking the republican position he himself held two years earlier in the same magazine — the positions and their reasons printed side by side
The evidence chain of the Journey to the New Continent: eyewitness records of tong wars in San Francisco's Chinatown and of New York's spoils politics — the raw data of the audit of degree
The measure of the polemic with the revolutionaries: he opposed 'republic in a hurry' yet shared the constitutional destination with them — the divide lay only in the path
modern_applications_zh: 组织转型：先做能力审计再定制度切换时点——给变革装'可滑动的阶梯'而非一刀切
分权设计：过渡授权必须写明'毕业条件与归还日期'——没有终点的授权是固守
个人升级：新习惯先设'过渡档'（降级版目标）——阶梯化比意志硬撑存活率高
modern_applications_en: Organisational transformation: run the capacity audit before setting the cutover date — fit the change with a slidable ladder, not a big-bang switch
Delegation design: transitional mandates must carry 'graduation conditions and a return date' — delegation without a terminus is entrenchment
Personal upgrades: give a new habit a 'transition tier' (a downgraded target) — the ladder survives where willpower alone fails
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
伯伦知理（思想源流：国家有机体学说——程度约束论的理论来源）
严复（同道：'民力民智民德'的渐进序列——同一阶梯意识的不同学科表述）

modes.domain_zh: 公共领域方法论/把思想竞争组织成公开的'观念市场'——主动迎战、指名交锋、让读者在对抗中完成教育
modes.domain_en: Public-sphere methodology / organising the contest of ideas into an open 'market of opinions' — accept the challenge, name the opponent, and let the readers be educated in the clash
modes.definition_zh: 公共领域方法论/梁启超是中国第一个自觉的'论战企业家'：与革命派（民报vs新民丛报）、与国体论者、与白话文运动各方的著名论战，多数由他把议题带进公开市场；操作结构有四：其一'议题设置权'——他发现'提出问题比赢的问题更值钱'（'新民''国体''科学精神'皆是他设置的议题）；其二'指名交锋'——论战点名到人、到文、到刊，读者可循线核对——公开市场要求可追溯的对抗；其三'阵地对等'——他的《新民丛报》与《民报》在同一场（东京）发售、同一读者群竞价——论战的输赢由读者用订阅投票；其四'败选守则'——1907 年《新民丛报》在与《民报》论战中实际败选（读者流失、停刊），他公开承认'革命之说日盛，吾党之力不能抗'——接受市场裁决而非操纵市场；这是把公共领域当竞争性市场的完整制度设计：议题、对手、裁判与败选规则缺一不可
modes.definition_en: Public-sphere methodology: Liang was China's first self-conscious 'entrepreneur of debate': the famous controversies with the revolutionaries (Min Bao versus the New People's Magazine), with the defenders of the republican form, with the vernacular movement — most were matters he himself carried into the open market; the operating structure has four parts: first, 'the power to set the agenda' — he discovered that raising a question is worth more than winning one ('the new citizen', 'the form of state', 'the scientific spirit' were all his agenda items); second, 'named engagement' — debate pointed to persons, essays and journals, checkable line by line — the open market demands traceable contest; third, 'parity of platforms' — his New People's Magazine and Min Bao sold in the same city (Tokyo) and bid for the same readers — the verdict of the debate was cast by readers with their subscriptions; fourth, 'the code of losing' — in 1907 the New People's Magazine in effect lost the debate with Min Bao (readers draining away, the magazine closed), and he admitted openly that 'the revolutionary doctrine daily flourishes; our party's strength cannot withstand it' — accepting the market's verdict rather than rigging the market; this is a complete institutional design of the public sphere as a competitive market: agenda, opponent, judge and the rules of losing — no one of the four may be absent
modes.source_chapter: 《新民丛报》与《民报》论战 (1905-1907)；《饮冰室合集》论战文字
modes.key_quote_zh: 革命之说日盛，吾党之力不能抗——论战是市场：输了就认，读者用订阅投票。
modes.key_quote_en: The revolutionary doctrine daily flourishes; our party's strength cannot withstand it — debate is a market: when you lose, admit it; the readers vote with their subscriptions.
key_concepts: 议题设置权 the agenda power（提出问题比赢的问题更值钱——设置议题是论战市场的第一资产）
the agenda power (raising the question outranks winning it — agenda-setting is the first asset of the debate market)
指名交锋 named engagement（点到人到文到刊、读者可核对——不可追溯的对抗不产生公共知识）
named engagement (persons, essays and journals named, readers able to check — untraceable contest yields no public knowledge)
败选守则 the code of losing（接受读者用订阅投出的裁决——操纵市场的论战毁掉市场本身）
the code of losing (accept the verdict cast by readers' subscriptions — a debate that rigs the market destroys the market)
process_zh: 先抢议题设置权：入场前问'我要新增什么问题'而非'我要赢哪个问题'——议题是资产，输赢是流量
指名与可追溯：论战必须点名、引原文、给出处——让第三方读者能核对每一回合
阵地对等：保证对手有对等发声渠道——不对等市场里赢了也不算数
预设败选守则：提前声明'输了我认什么'——订阅量/支持率下跌即接受裁决，不掀桌子
process_en: Seize the agenda first: before entering, ask 'what question do I add' rather than 'which question do I win' — agenda is the asset, win-loss is the traffic
Named and traceable: every debate must name names, quote originals, give sources — let third-party readers verify each round
Parity of platforms: guarantee the opponent an equal channel — a victory in a lopsided market does not count
Pre-set the code of losing: declare in advance 'what I concede when I lose' — falling subscriptions or support is the verdict, accepted, not overturned
representative_cases_zh: 《民报》与《新民丛报》大论战 (1905-1907)：双刊在东京同售、南洋同销——中国第一次由读者订阅裁决的思想对决
1907 年败选与停刊：新民丛报销量崩落后他公开承认论战失利——败选守则的历史实证
与《国故》派的文言白话之争虽处下风仍全程公开：晚年他不再设议题却仍守市场规则
representative_cases_en: The great debate of Min Bao and the New People's Magazine (1905-07): the two journals sold side by side in Tokyo and the South Seas — China's first contest of ideas adjudicated by readers' subscriptions
The loss and the closing of 1907: with the magazine's sales collapsed he admitted the defeat of the debate in print — the historical proof of the code of losing
The classical-vernacular controversy with the Gugu school, fought openly though at a disadvantage: in late life he no longer set the agenda yet still kept the rules of the market
modern_applications_zh: 技术方案评审：设'指名交锋'规则——反对意见必须署名、可核对，匿名反对不入议程
市场竞争：把'议题设置权'当第一资产——定义问题者获得规则制定权
组织治理：重大分歧设'败选守则'——投票/订阅结果出来后输方公开认账，不搞场外翻案
modern_applications_en: Technical review: set rules of 'named engagement' — objections must be signed and checkable; anonymous objections enter no agenda
Market competition: treat agenda-setting as the first asset — whoever defines the problem holds the rule-making power
Organisational governance: for major disagreements set a 'code of losing' — once the vote or the subscriptions are in, the loser concedes in public, no back-alley reversal
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
弥尔顿（思想源流：观念自由市场的最早辩护——论战市场法的西方源头）
章太炎（同道/对手：民报主笔——论战市场的另一方操盘手）

modes.domain_zh: 个人管理方法论/以内热如焚的危机感驱动终身自课——'饮冰室'的书房是自我更新的流水线：每天固定课时，衰年变法
modes.domain_en: Personal-management methodology / a lifelong self-curriculum driven by an inner heat of crisis — the 'ice-drinking studio' a production line of self-renewal: fixed daily lessons, and reform in one's declining years
modes.definition_zh: 个人管理方法论/梁启超自号'饮冰室主人'——内热如焚，饮冰自解：这个意象概括了他的自我治理方式——以对时代危机的切身焦虑为恒定动力源，把'跟上时代'变成每天的自课制度；操作上他与司马光的警枕法同构而更进一步：其一'衰年变法'——五十岁后系统学习新学科（晚年转向佛学考据、先秦政治思想史，五十余岁学写毛笔字之外的西式学术规范），公开承认'学问欲'不衰；其二'写作即课程'——他的学习从不以'读完'为目的，以'写成'为目的：每学一科必产出讲义或专著（先秦政治思想史、清代学术概论皆是自课的副产品）；其三'日课定额'——流亡与多病中仍保持每天数千字的写作定额，'每日必动笔'是铁律；他五十六岁病逝，生前最后几年仍以病躯完成《中国近三百年学术史》等巨著——自课法的本质是把'我是不是过时了'的焦虑，转译为'今天交了多少'的账目
modes.definition_en: Personal-management methodology: Liang styled himself 'Master of the Ice-Drinking Studio' — a fire within, quenched by drinking ice: the image sums up his self-governance — the felt anxiety of the age's crisis as a constant power source, 'keeping up with the times' turned into a daily system of self-lessons; structurally it is one with Sima Guang's log-pillow yet goes further: first, 'reform in the declining years' — after fifty he studied whole new fields (turning in late life to Buddhist textual criticism and the intellectual history of pre-Qin political thought, learning in his fifties the norms of Western scholarship beyond the writing brush), professing openly that his 'thirst for learning' had not decayed; second, 'writing as curriculum' — his study never aimed at 'having read' but at 'having written': every subject studied produced lectures or a monograph (the intellectual history of pre-Qin thought and the Intellectual Trends of the Qing are by-products of self-lessons); third, the daily quota — through exile and chronic illness he kept a writing quota of several thousand characters a day; 'the brush must move every day' was iron law; he died at fifty-six, his last years finishing the Intellectual History of the Last Three Hundred Years from a sickbed — the essence of the self-curriculum is translating the anxiety 'am I obsolete' into the account 'how much did I deliver today'
modes.source_chapter: 饮冰室自号与《饮冰室合集》；梁启勋等兄弟忆述其日课习惯；《中国近三百年学术史》成书背景
modes.key_quote_zh: 内热如焚，饮冰自课——'我是不是过时了'不是用来焦虑的，是用来折算成今天交了多少字的。
modes.key_quote_en: A fire within, quenched by drinking ice — the question 'am I obsolete' is not for brooding; it is for converting into how many characters were delivered today.
key_concepts: 焦虑转账本 anxiety into the ledger（对过时的恐惧折算为日产出定额——情绪能源的工程化利用）
anxiety into the ledger (the dread of obsolescence converted into a daily output quota — the engineering use of emotion as energy)
写作即课程 writing as curriculum（每学一科必产出讲义/专著——输入以输出验收，学过才算学过）
writing as curriculum (every subject studied must yield lectures or a monograph — input accepted only as validated by output)
衰年变法 reform in the declining years（五十岁后仍系统入新学科——自课制度的期限是生命不是年龄）
reform in the declining years (whole new fields entered after fifty — the self-curriculum's deadline is one's life, not one's age)
process_zh: 设情绪能源转化器：把对'跟不上时代'的恐惧写成每日产出定额——焦虑不定性为情绪，定量为字数/课时
以输出验收输入：每学一个新领域，先预设一个产出物（讲义/文章/书）——没产出的学习不算完成
铁律日课：产出定额写进日程且不可协商——多病、流亡、政务都是变量，定额是常量
设'衰年变法'条款：年龄增长反而提高学习配额——定期强制进入自己不擅长的新学科
process_en: Build the emotion-to-ledger converter: write the fear of 'falling behind' as a daily output quota — quantify the anxiety as characters or lesson-hours, do not leave it as mood
Accept input only as validated by output: for each new field, pre-set a deliverable (lectures, an essay, a book) — study without output does not count as done
Iron-law daily lessons: the quota enters the calendar as non-negotiable — illness, exile and office are variables; the quota is the constant
Insert the 'declining-years reform' clause: with age, raise the learning quota — enter by force of schedule an unfamiliar new field at fixed intervals
representative_cases_zh: 饮冰室日课：流亡日本时期同时办报、写作、办学——每天数千字的定额在多线作战中保持
《清代学术概论》的十五天成书：1920 年应蒋方震之约为其书作序，'下笔不能自休'遂成专著——自课惯性的极端展示
最后岁月：肾疾术后仍以病躯完成《中国近三百年学术史》与先秦诸子讲义——自课制度执行到生命最后一两年
representative_cases_en: The ice-drinking daily lessons: in the Japanese exile years he ran a magazine, wrote, and taught at once — several thousand characters a day held amid multi-front operations

The Intellectual Trends written in fifteen days: in 1920 asked to preface Jiang Fangzhen's book, 'the brush would not stop', and the preface grew into a monograph — the extreme display of self-curriculum inertia

The last years: after kidney surgery, from a sickbed he finished the Intellectual History of the Last Three Hundred Years and lectures on the pre-Qin thinkers — the system executed to the final year or two of life
modern_applications_zh: 终身学习：把'怕过时'折算成每周产出定额——用交付物验收学习而非用打卡
多线并行：多项目作战时保住'日课常量'——变量再多，当天定额不可让
中年转型：给自己设'衰年变法'条款——每年强制进入一个完全陌生的新学科并产出
modern_applications_en: Lifelong learning: convert the fear of obsolescence into a weekly output quota — validate study by deliverables, not by streaks
Multi-front operations: hold the 'daily-lesson constant' across many projects — whatever the variables, today's quota is not negotiable
Mid-career transition: write yourself a 'declining-years reform' clause — every year forcibly enter an alien new field and produce from it
representative_figures: 梁启超（核心）
司马光（对照：警枕法——同为装置化自我纪律，司马光防懈怠、梁启超防过时）
富兰克林（同道：十三美德的记分册——把自我改进写成可数账目的同一传统）
